title: Delete or wire the abandoned AddTrackController/TrackBlueprintDraftRepository/TrackBlueprint migration trio (~1,200 dead lines)
rule: Dead-code sweep + Fowler (speculative generality never adopted)
why: grep across lib/ shows zero production references to AddTrackController, AddTrackFlowState, TrackBlueprintDraftRepository(+Impl), AddTrackDraft, TrackBlueprint, or ProvisionTrackUseCase outside their own files — the live wizard entry points (add_track_flow_screen.dart, track_management_hub_screen.dart, onboarding_screen.dart, track_management_body.dart) all instantiate the raw AddTrackFlow ConsumerStatefulWidget with its own hand-rolled SharedPreferences persistence and call TrackCreationService.createTrack(AddTrackResult,...) directly, never touching the typed/riverpod replacement layer. Each dead piece still has its own dedicated, passing test suite (add_track_controller_test.dart 298 lines, track_blueprint_draft_repository_impl_test.dart 115 lines, track_blueprint_test.dart 268 lines, provision_track_use_case_test.dart 460 lines = 1,141 test lines) pinning behavior nobody exercises. Worse, AddTrackController's SharedPreferences keys (_kStep='add_track_step' etc.) are byte-identical to the live AddTrackFlow's keys (_kAddTrackStep='add_track_step' etc.) — if either implementation is ever revived independently they will silently clobber each other's saved wizard state.
recommendation: Delete the 6 dead source files and their 4 dedicated test files, or finish the migration and actually wire AddTrackFlow through AddTrackController/TrackBlueprint. If kept temporarily, rename one set of SharedPreferences key constants so they cannot collide.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rL for AddTrackController/TrackBlueprintDraftRepository/TrackBlueprint outside their own definition files finds a real call site, or the files are removed
test/features/track_setup/presentation/controllers/add_track_controller_test.dart and the other dead-code test files are deleted or repointed at a live call site
